headline: China Grants Citigroup Approval for Wholly-Owned Securities Venture
summary: China has granted regulatory approval to Citigroup to set up a wholly-owned securities company as part of its ongoing financial market opening push.
why: Foreign investment banks seek direct control over Chinese securities businesses to tap domestic underwriting, advisory, and trading volumes.

impacts.name: Citigroup Inc
impacts.why: Securing a wholly-owned securities license expands Citi's operational reach and revenue generation across mainland Chinese capital markets.
